items.name: deep-research
items.title: Deep Research
items.description: In-depth research agent for topics that need multi-source investigation with citations. Use when the user asks to research a topic thoroughly, synthesize information from across the web, compare options, fact-check a claim against primary sources, or produce a sourced writeup or literature scan, for example "compare Postgres vs SQLite for an offline-first app, with sources".
items.author: Khaled Saeed
